title: Statewide interoperable communications executive committee.
bodyText: There is established within the department of law enforcement for administrative purposes the statewide interoperable communications executive committee.
bodyHtml: §128A-12  Statewide interoperable communications executive committee.  There is established within the department of law enforcement for administrative purposes the statewide interoperable communications executive committee. [L 2022, c 97, pt of §2; am L 2023, c 186, §3]
